proposed_example.formal_evidence_scope: Exact existing canonical declaration only; ASTIS-authored library generalization, not a paper theorem on arbitrary spaces.
proposed_example.parameters: Any measurable carrier and common reference measure; two pointwise nonnegative measurable genuinely L1 real functions, each of integral one. No finite, probability or sigma-finite reference-measure assumption.

an actual independent-block target law, product affinity=a^k, tensorization or amplified TV
